My dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939)
A proof of the history of St Louis, I suppose [M. Guizot](/person/597)’s has come here, but I do not know the why or wherefore. Is it a mistake?[^1]
[Mrs Valentine](/person/1437) ([Mr Warne](/person/1433)’s reader) says they do not know anything of having had '[Wooed and Won](/topic/202)' sent in. Perhaps you would kindly ask whoever was your messenger to whom he gave it

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
Would you kindly have both the [Cameos](/book/73) and [Historical Selections](/book/71) sent to [Madame de Witt](/person/423)


[^1]: Black-edged paper.
